symbols.reasoning: Event RequestId early replay returns requested delivery current status. New request only Delivered/Failed/Returned enum values accepted, actor authorized before transaction. Locks delivery row and returns no-write if already requested status, even new RequestId/amount; otherwise validates transition, reads associated order/facts. Delivered defaults Collected to computed whole responsibility, requires reason for variance, updates delivery and existing custody collected/difference. Failed/Returned validate reason and stamp outcome. Version/event/audit Save atomically; no order.IsPaid/electronic change or treasury movement. Same-status different amount silently ignored by intentional no-op, so correction workflow cannot be assumed available.
